description: Keyword search across guide titles, section headings, body text and glossary terms. Returns the best matches with the page URL and a short snippet. Use wrs_get_guide for the full text of a match.

language.description: Restrict to one language: en, es, tl, zh, vi, ko. Default: all languages (search in the language of the query).

query.description: Words or a phrase to look for, e.g. 'errata sheet deadline' or 'remote deposition oath'.

name: wrs_search
title: Search guides and glossary
